request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: multiple-correct (one or more options are right)

A sample of nuclei X contains 48 × 10^23 nuclei at some time and reduced to 6 × 10^23 nuclei in 3 minutes. The mean life of nucleus X is roughly?
(A) 0.693 min
(B) 1.44 min
(C) 2.079 min
(D) 4.329 min

result.working:
N0/N = 48×10^23 / 6×10^23 = 8 = 2^3, so 3 half-lives pass in 3 min.
Half-life T½ = 3 min / 3 = 1 min.
Mean life τ = T½/ln2 = 1/0.693 ≈ 1.443 min.
The other options are 0.693 (= ln 2), 2.079 (= 3 ln 2) and 4.329 (= 3/ln 2), none of which equals τ, so only B is correct.
result.note: The question is labelled multiple-correct, but only one option (B) is correct.
